segments.name: Institutional lending
segments.description: Originates and invests in secured commercial real estate loans for high-quality borrowers and sponsors with transitional business plans.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one operating segment and has one reportable operating segment for activities related to institutional lending.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay the company for secured commercial real estate loans it originates and invests in.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company generates revenue from originating and investing in secured CRE loans and providing capital to high-quality borrowers and sponsors with transitional business plans collateralized by CRE assets with opportunities for near-term value creation, as well as recapitalization opportunities.
